card.name: Digits and labels inside references and codes
card.fires_on: Digits or label words partway through project numbers, page ranges, dates, and named scales, where a letter or number is expected next. Examples are a middle digit of a page range, the E in CTCAE, or Class after Child-Pugh.

modes.label: Digits in numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a project number, page range, year, or isotope name.

modes.label: Label words in scale names
modes.description: A word such as Class or Cycle, or a final letter, completing a named scale or version label.
modes.example: With severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh<< Class>> C).
